objective: Reduce OPEN_BRIDGE_003 Appendix F obligations by defining a provisional unresolved-continuation carrier, admissibility-preserving handoff operator, trace preservation rule, and orientation-reference continuity condition.

formalization.handoff_form: H_adm(UC_i, tau_{i->j}) -> UC_j | bottom_C^{type} | bottom_C^{adm} | bottom_C^{trace}

obligation_reduction.resolution: Unresolved continuation is defined as UC(C_i; D_i, R_i, O_i, B_i).
Admissible meta-relation handoff is defined as H_adm over a declared domain transition tau_{i->j}.
Domain-transition trace preservation is defined by TraceInv with required recoverable invariants.
Orientation-reference continuity is defined by ORC under the declared transition type.

non_promotion_boundaries: OPEN_BRIDGE_003 is not supported by this patch.
No subjective continuity claim is admitted.
No consciousness persistence claim is admitted.
No observer persistence claim is admitted.
No primitive time claim is admitted.
No trans-domain identity survival claim is admitted.
No empirical continuity claim is admitted.
